watches.name: Visionnaire
watches.description: The Visionnaire combines classic Art Deco proportions with modern sportiness in a compact rectangular case. Its sculpted flanks bring strength and subtle sporty character, and every Visionnaire features a sapphire crystal with seven-layer anti-reflective coating and a hardened, anti-fingerprint top layer. Each watch comes in beautiful, gift-worthy packaging.

watches.name: Heritage Chronograph
watches.description: As many elder siblings will attest to, the introduction of a new family member often comes with its complications. Our latest addition to the Heritage lineage is no exception. However, with the new Heritage Chronograph, things are complicated in the best of ways thanks to the addition of our first-ever complication: Seiko’s renowned VK64 Hybrid Movement. And as looks matter too, you’ll find a stunning pitch black dial and a perfectly sized case that together equal its intricate interior. Complicated yet surprisingly straightforward. Dare we say it’s the best of two worlds?

watches.name: Historique
watches.description: The Historique features a classic two-tone dial – a hallmark often found on vintage pieces from the past. Our slightly modernised take features an Eggshel White center and a polished Cercle d’Acier ring in steel, clearly inspired by watches from the past and also a signature look from our C-series. Additionally, the watch features polished steel or rose gold markers and hands which creates a special effect against the shimmering brushed silver beneath

watches.name: Heritage 36
watches.description: The Heritage 36 combines classic details with a completely revamped gold case. Featuring a sleeker and more elegant look than ever before, its redesigned curved lugs offer the perfect fit with a snug dark brown leather strap. Brand new pointed hour markers and delicate dauphine hands ensure the perfect proportions whilst the blue anodized hands of the white dial version provide an exciting contrast we’ve all grown to love. The Heritage 36’s stylish looks makes it the perfect dress watch – but then again, it’ll look just as good on the beach.
